description: Adds tags to, or removes tags from, one contact, named by id, without touching the rest of its tags. action add leaves a tag the contact already has as it is; action remove skips a tag it does not have. tags is the list of tag names. The change stays inside Cosend. Returns the contact.

action.description: add to put tags on the contact, remove to take them off.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: tag_contact
title: Tag or untag a contact
